rules.statement: A purchaser from a landlord who has incurred expenditure on improvements is entitled to claim the permitted increase of rent from the tenant who has attorned to him.
rules.supporting_quote: The plaintiff was not entitled to maintain a claim that the standard rent be increased by the amount calculated at the rate specified in the said section 6 (1) (b) for the reason that the expenditure was incurred by his vendor and not by him. If the permitted increase which is said to be about Rs. 35 per mensem is added to the admitted standard rent, the authorized rent would be Rs. 126/91.
